blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A lone bettor won the ₱44.2 million Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot on Friday, Nov. 27, while no player won the ₱603.58 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 top prize. According to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO), the winning combination for Mega Lotto 6/45 was 33-37-36-26-23-03. READ: Lotto Results Today – November 27, 2026 Meanwhile, no bettor matched the Ultra Lotto 6/58 winning combination of 18-13-06-07-05-45.
